WITH equipment_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_avg_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.equipref,
    ea.avg_humidity,
    ov.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_avg ea, overall_avg_value ov
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity > ov.overall_avg
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_avg_equipment
)
SELECT 
  aae.equipref,
  aae.avg_humidity,
  aae.avg_humidity - aae.overall_avg as exceeds_all_avg,
  aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean as exceeds_group_mean
FROM above_avg_equipment aae
CROSS JOIN group_stats gs
WHERE aae.overall_avg IS NOT NULL 
  AND gs.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN (aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         (aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean) DESC,
         aae.equipref
LIMIT 10
